Thought: The 13C NMR spectra data provides the chemical shifts: 139.25, 134.60, 129.00, 129.00, 128.30, 128.30, 49.40, 26.10, and 11.40. To determine the number of unique carbon environments, I need to count the distinct chemical shifts, considering that identical shifts indicate chemically equivalent carbons.

The unique chemical shifts are: 139.25, 134.60, 129.00, 128.30, 49.40, 26.10, and 11.40. Therefore, there are 7 unique carbon environments.
